## Questions about AI for meetings

Yes. Cedric writes a brief from what your workspace knows: what to say, what to ask and what to keep to yourself. You say go, or change it. He opens the call by saying who he is there for, asks your questions one at a time and tells the room he will pass anything else on to you. He never agrees to a price, a date or a decision in your name. The notes come to you first.

Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams. Cedric joins as a guest named Cedric, so the host admits him like anyone else. He shares his screen in Google Meet and Zoom.

Yes. Give Cedric a PowerPoint file or a public web page before the call, or ask him to write the slides. He shares them and talks through each one. Say "next slide" or "go back to pricing" and he goes there. [...] Google Calendar
